run_training_experiment: run a training experiment using launch.py with a config file via the -c flag
launch_tensorboard: launch tensorboard for an experiment directory using launch.py with the --tb flag
kill_slurm_jobs: kill all SLURM jobs for a given config using launch.py with the -k flag
run_local_debug: run a local debug training job with 1 GPU using launch.py with the -g flag
run_test_mode: run a test-only evaluation using launch.py with the -t flag to pick the last checkpoint
